stem.text: Gaseous hydrogen and gaseous iodine react to form gaseous hydrogen iodide.
In an experiment, $2.0\,\text{mol}$ of hydrogen and $2.0\,\text{mol}$ of iodine are placed in a sealed container of volume $1.0\,\text{dm}^{3}$.
The $K_\text{c}$ value for this reaction under the conditions used is $9.0$.
How many moles of hydrogen iodide are present at equilibrium?
